# libc/libm names that libghostty-vt's archive members define (compiler_rt.o, and the
# quirks memset in libghostty-vt-static_zcu.o). build-ghostty-vt-linux.sh localizes them
# with `objcopy --localize-symbols` so the final executable binds these names to glibc.
# Generated by `scripts/build-ghostty-vt-linux.sh --update-lists`; see docs/linux/vendoring.md.
